plainText:
Linnea (Japanese: アサミ Asami) is a from the Laverre Gym. In , she is a recurring character who first appeared in A Fashionable Battle!.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
Linnea is a loyal to Laverre City Gym Leader Valerie. When Sawyer came to Laverre City to ask for a Gym , Linnea told him that Valerie wasn't available at the moment due to her collection being displayed in a fashion show. During the fashion show, Linnea picked Sawyer from the audience to battle against Valerie in an official Gym battle that was part of the show.

Linnea reappeared in Fairy-Type Trickery!, where she was following and Valerie's Gym battle.

She reappeared in a flashback in Till We Compete Again!.

====Voice actors====
 

==In the games==
Linnea appears in Pokémon X and Y as one of the s in the Laverre Gym.

===Pokémon===
 
 
 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Linnea forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Linnea became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2026.

==Quotes==
 

==Trivia==
Linnea shares her name in Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, Korean, and Chinese with Asami.
Linnea is characterized in the games as being focused on learning from Valerie to become a fashion designer, and Asami is a fashion designer in Lumiose City five years after the events of X and Y. However, due to their drastically different character designs, the relationship between the two characters is unknown, and may be coincidental or a simple reference.
